note: The parser merges GML key/value nodes and frees the second tree object after its contents have been merged into the first tree.
The merge transfers child pointers from t2 into t1, so later tree destruction must not free t2 again.
Tree destruction assumes the node still owns its children; after mergedest has moved them away, destroying the old tree violates that ownership invariant.
The destructor recursively follows and frees child pointers, which becomes a use-after-free when it is invoked on the already-freed merged tree.
